comment: session.list with `title` — the exact-title registry branch, methods_session.py:180-221. Frame 1 is what a gateway that HAS the branch answers: a literal one-element list (:205-217) with seven keys, where id is the row carrying the title and resolved_id is the live compression tip, so the two differ once the conversation has rotated. started_at comes from the root row and message_count from the tip; preview is empty because the tip is a get_session() row and preview is a field only list_sessions_rich derives. Hidden rows resolve here — the branch returns before include_hidden is read at :228 — and archived / kanban / tool rows come back as {"sessions": []}, an empty success rather than an error. Frame 2 is what an OLDER gateway answers to the same request: it does not know the param, ignores it, and returns its ordinary windowed listing (:223-259) — six keys, no resolved_id, none of them titled "Bot Chat". That frame is why the client-side exact-title filter exists (plugin.js:4316-4320): trusting sessions[0] here would adopt an unrelated conversation as the bot's forever chat.
